metadata.description: SkaFld VC: venture capital agents and skills for Claude. Install SkaFld VC: it runs only its two local servers, uses the research and data connectors you add (Exa and Apollo recommended) and writes designed files on a computer with Node.js. Add SkaFld VC Platform only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc
plugins.description: Start here. Sourcing, screening, diligence plans, IC memos and portfolio reviews, with returns, valuation, term sheets, unit economics and cap tables, from your own documents. Research with the connectors you add (Exa and Apollo recommended; data, CRM and notes connectors used once you add them), and designed HTML, Word, PDF, deck and Excel files (needs Node.js 18 or later; without it, Claude's own document tools). Works with no platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc-platform
plugins.displayName: SkaFld VC Platform (for SkaFld platform customers)
plugins.description: Only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform: connects SkaFld VC to your firm's pipeline, documents, rubric and house profile, and installs SkaFld VC with it. Asks for your platform's address. No platform? Use SkaFld VC on its own, or contact hello@skafldstudio.com to get one.
